01 / 18
Vision●Built◆In build

Celebrate exploration, not speed.

A lifestyle brand with a useful product, for touring and adventure riders in India.

  • Explore●BuiltA trusted trails database: may I ride it, can I ride it now, how do we know.
  • Ride●BuiltRecord rides, keep a journal, plan routes, ride together.
  • Equip●Built◆In buildFix-it guides are built. The Shop discovery layer is in build.
  • Connect●Built◆In buildClubs and group rides are built. Achievements and contribution tooling are in build.

Riders contribute trails, conditions and photos. It is not a social network: no follows, likes or rankings.

Sources: PRODUCT.md; docs/15 "deliberately not in the first release"

02 / 18
Problem▲Hypothesis

The journey is scattered across tools that do not know each other.

Trail access, rides, group coordination and gear live in different places.

  1. 01

    Access is hard to trust

    Trail access and condition sit in posts and pins with no evidence, expiry or moderation story.

  2. 02

    Group rides run on chat

    Club rides are coordinated in chat groups and payment screenshots, with no roster or capacity.

  3. 03

    Rides leave no record

    A good ride vanishes: no journal, no recap, no memory of places reached.

  4. 04

    Gear is detached from the trip

    What to carry, how to fix it and where to buy it are separate searches.

These statements come from product docs and one competitor review. They are not user research. Testing them with riders is a Foundation task.

Sources: docs/01, docs/02, docs/competitive/2026-11-01-ridingverse-analysis.md §3

03 / 18
Audience▲Hypothesis

Touring and adventure riders who ride out, and ride together.

Three roles, one rider. Participants never pay.

Riders

Weekend and multi-day touring and adventure riders in India. Free: explore, record, fix, join any group ride.

Organisers

Club road captains and ride leaders. They pay for capacity above 5 riders. The buyer.

Contributors

Riders who add trails, conditions and photos. Credited, moderated, never paid per item. The supply side.

No rider count, market size or willingness to pay has been measured. Measuring them is the first job of the year.

08 / 18
Engagement◆In build

Reward reaching places, never speed.

Trailmarks and challenges are in build, not verified.

  • Trailmarks

    The unit of reward is a place reached, not a time.

  • Challenges

    Time-boxed, exploration-based, no speed or risk element.

  • No leaderboards

    No public rankings between riders: they reward speed and risk (docs/15).

  • Credit for contributors

    Recognition and Marks, not cash per item.

Marks on the device are built. Trailmarks, challenges and achievements are in build by other agents and are not verified.

09 / 18
Equip: the Shop◆In build

A Shop for the ride, kept outside the app.

Physical goods only, at shop.myto-moto.com. Myto Originals and curated third party.

  • Physical goods only

    No digital unlock is ever sold in the Shop.

  • Myto Originals

    Our own products. Myto earns the margin.

  • Curated third party

    Chosen on stated criteria. Myto earns a commission, not the sale.

  • Always labelled

    Original, Partner or Affiliate, in text.

  • Discovery layer

    In build: shows relevant gear in context, links out, no in-app payment.

₹71,229Shop GMV, base scenario, year one (customer-paid, incl. GST)▲Hypothesis
₹33,201Myto's own take on it (Originals sales ex-GST plus commission)▲Hypothesis

GMV is not Myto's income. Figures are assumptions. Store policy: physical goods are outside in-app purchase (Apple 3.1.3(e); Google Payments policy). The flat lay is illustrative, not a product.

Assumptions: Base: 5% of active riders open the link, 3% of them order, average order ₹1,800, Originals 50% of orders at 40% gross margin, curated commission 10%. Sources: monetisation-model.md §4

12 / 18
Advertising and partnerships▲Hypothesis

Commerce never touches trust.

Advertising is deferred. These rules are fixed now.

  1. 01

    Always labelled

    Sponsored, Partner, Affiliate or Original, in words, in every placement.

  2. 02

    Never influences safety

    Not conditions, verification, access status, search order or moderation.

  3. 03

    Never sells location

    No location, ride or contact data, ever. Only aggregate counts.

  4. 04

    No ads in safety flows

    Not in Help, SOS, check-in, live group view or recording.

  5. 05

    No advertising identifiers

    No cross-app tracking (docs/15).

  6. 06

    Curated means chosen

    By Myto, on stated criteria, not by the highest bidder.

No partner is contracted. Sponsored challenge pilot is a hypothesis for Phase 3.

Sources: monetisation-model.md §5; docs/15

13 / 18
Go to market○Planned

Start where the verified trails are.

Bengaluru and the weekend-ride radius, then only if it works.

  • Region

    Four approved trails, all in or beside Bengaluru. Test rides and captures are local. Other states: coming soon.

  • Founding cohort

    50 to 100 contributors by personal invitation, with club road captains first.

  • Content

    Trail of the month, ride reports with GPX, Fix-it short guides, Year-in-rides cards.

  • Partners

    Clubs, curated gear brands, route homestays and mechanics. None contracted.

Approved trails in the repo (not samples)

Hesaraghatta WetlandsBengaluru Urban2 km
Manchanabele DamBengaluru South37 km
Bettahalasuru LakeBengaluru Urban1 km
Thippagondanahalli ReservoirBengaluru Urban0.5 km

All four are in Karnataka, in or beside Bengaluru. Six further trails in the seed data are flagged sample and are not coverage.

Evidence is where the team has worked, not measured demand. Live trail and club counts were not queried for this deck.

Sources: apps/web/data/trails; strategy.md §6
